# Agent tools

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_tools_doc.py from agent/tools.py — do not edit by hand. -->

61 built-in tools (schemas and dispatch in `backend/agent/tools.py`). MCP servers add their own tools at runtime as `mcp_<server>_<tool>`. `?` marks an optional parameter. *(host exec)* tools are only offered where `AGENT_HOST_EXEC` allows them (interactive chat and coding tasks by default).

| Tool | What it does | Parameters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `analyze_company_financials` | Perform a vertical common size analysis, calculate key financial ratios, or analyze Year-over-Year (YoY) growth patterns for a company using direct SEC/EDGAR XBRL data. | `ticker`, `analysis_type`, `years`? |
| `analyze_earnings_call` | Extract key business themes, revenue guidance, product updates, and executive sentiment from an earnings call transcript file in the workspace using the LLM. | `file_path`, `extract_guidance`? |
| `approve_merge` | Approve and EXECUTE a topic-merge proposal. | `proposal_id`, `canonical_label` |
| `batch_convert_documents` | Batch-convert multiple files matching wildcards, folder names, or specific paths in the workspace into another format. | `paths`, `target_format`, `out_dir`?, `save_as_artifact`? |
| `batch_ingest_sources` | Run ingest_source over a list of items with per-item failure isolation. | `items` |
| `code_execute` *(host exec)* | Execute a code snippet in an isolated sandbox and return its stdout, stderr, and exit code. | `language`, `code`, `filename`?, `timeout_seconds`? |
| `compare_company_strategy_and_risks` | Extract, summarize, and compare corporate strategy, R&D patterns, and risk factors from company annual reports (10-K filings) using the LLM. | `tickers`, `focus_areas`?, `year`? |
| `consolidate_memory` | Run memory consolidation: summarize the current session, extract entities/facts/relationships from recent conversation, and store them in semantic and graph memory. | — |
| `convert_document` | Convert a single document in the workspace from one format to another (e.g. .md to .html, .docx to .pdf, .pdf to .txt). | `source_path`, `target_format`, `out_dir`?, `save_as_artifact`? |
| `create_graph_node` | Create a node in the associative graph memory to represent a concept, person, project, or fact. | `node_type`, `label`, `metadata`? |
| `create_skill` | Create a reusable SKILL (invoked with /skill-name in chat) — not a scheduled task (create_task). | `name`, `description`, `triggers`?, `tags`?, `instructions` |
| `create_task` | Schedule an autonomous background task. | `name`, `description`, `schedule`, `timeout_seconds`?, `max_iterations`?, `skill_name`?, `plan`, `skip_review`?, `job_type`?, `max_turns`?, `execute_instruction`?, `review_instruction`?, `branch_strategy`? |
| `download_file` | Download a file from a URL and save it to the workspace. | `url`, `path`, `filename`? |
| `extract_topics` | Run topic extraction on an existing artifact (or raw text) and return the structured topics / speakers / claims without writing them anywhere. | `artifact_id`?, `text`?, `strategy`?, `max_topics`? |
| `force_merge` | Manually merge two topic nodes by label, bypassing the proposal queue. | `label_a`, `label_b`, `canonical_label` |
| `generate_image` | Generate image(s) with the configured image model, or edit an existing image. | `prompt`, `source_image`?, `size`?, `n`?, `quality`?, `path`?, `name`? |
| `get_job_status` | Get the current state of a background job. | `job_id` |
| `get_self_documentation` | Retrieve the system self-documentation. | — |
| `git_commit` *(host exec)* | Stage files and commit them on the CURRENT branch of the local repo checkout. | `message`, `files`? |
| `git_create_branch` *(host exec)* | Create and switch to a new local git branch. | `branch_name` |
| `git_merge` *(host exec)* | Merge a branch into the CURRENT branch of the local repo checkout. | `branch`?, `message`?, `abort`? |
| `git_push_pr` *(host exec)* | Push the current git branch to the remote GitHub repository and create a Pull Request. | `title`, `body`?, `base`? |
| `git_status` *(host exec)* | Show the local git working tree status (runs git status --porcelain). | — |
| `git_sync_repo` *(host exec)* | Clone the project's bound GitHub repo into the local workspace (or fetch + fast-forward it if already cloned) and return the checkout path. | `branch`?, `fresh`? |
| `github_create_branch` | Create a new branch off the default branch (or a named base branch) in the GitHub repo bound to this project. | `new_branch`, `base_branch`? |
| `github_create_pr` | Open a pull request in the GitHub repo bound to this project. | `title`, `head`, `base`?, `body`?, `draft`? |
| `github_delete_branch` | Delete a branch from the GitHub repo bound to this project. | `branch` |
| `github_list_branches` | List all branches in the GitHub repo bound to this project. | `name_prefix`? |
| `github_list_connections` | Diagnostic only — list configured GitHub PATs and show which one is bound to this project. | — |
| `github_list_directory` | List files and folders at a path in the GitHub repo bound to this project. | `path`?, `ref`? |
| `github_list_pulls` | List pull requests in the GitHub repo bound to this project. | `state`?, `head`?, `base`? |
| `github_merge_pr` | Merge a previously-opened pull request in the GitHub repo bound to this project. | `pr_number`, `merge_method`? |
| `github_read_file` | Read a file from the GitHub repo bound to this project. | `path`, `ref`? |
| `github_write_files` | Atomically commit one or more files to a branch in the GitHub repo bound to this project. | `branch`, `message`, `files` |
| `index_artifact` | Index one artifact, or every artifact under a path prefix, into semantic memory + knowledge graph. | `id`?, `path_prefix`?, `force`? |
| `index_workspace` | Index workspace files into semantic memory and knowledge graph. | `path`?, `force`? |
| `ingest_source` | Ingest one item through a source adapter: fetch server-side, extract topics, save as an artifact (re-ingesting the same item updates it), embed and link the graph. | `source_type`, `identifier`, `extras`? |
| `link_concepts` | Create a relationship edge between two nodes in the associative graph memory. | `node_a_label`, `node_b_label`, `relationship` |
| `link_topic_similarity` | Backfill the cross-artifact similarity pipeline for already-indexed artifacts. | `path_prefix`?, `link_threshold`?, `merge_threshold`? |
| `list_artifacts` | List artifacts in the active project. | `tag`?, `content_type`?, `path_prefix`?, `search`?, `limit`? |
| `list_merge_proposals` | List pending (or all) topic-merge proposals for the current project. | `status`?, `limit`? |
| `list_recent_jobs` | List recent background jobs for the active project. | `status`?, `include_system`?, `limit`? |
| `list_source_adapters` | List the source adapters registered in the project. | — |
| `list_workspace_files` | List scratch files in the project workspace. | `path`? |
| `read_artifact` | Read an artifact by id or by path. | `id`?, `path`? |
| `read_file` | Read a scratch file from the project workspace (sandbox runs, raw uploads). | `path` |
| `recall` | Search the project's memory across episodic (past chats), semantic (indexed artifacts and workspace files), and graph (linked concepts) tiers. | `query`, `tiers`? |
| `reject_merge` | Mark a merge proposal as rejected. | `proposal_id` |
| `remember` | Store information in memory for future recall: 'episodic' for a dated note about this conversation, 'semantic' for a key insight or fact to find by meaning later, 'graph' to extract the entities and relationships in the text into the kno… | `content`, `tier`, `metadata`? |
| `rerun_job` | Re-run a finished job (completed / failed / stalled / cancelled) with the exact same payload, title, schedule_id, and timeout. | `job_id` |
| `run_command` *(host exec)* | Run a shell (bash) command inside the project's local repo checkout (created by git_sync_repo), or the project workspace if no checkout exists. | `command`, `workdir`?, `timeout_seconds`? |
| `save_last_response` | Save recent conversation as an artifact. | `path`, `history_count`?, `mode`?, `custom_prompt`?, `title`?, `tags`?, `prepend_header`? |
| `save_to_artifact` | Save content into the user's Pantheon artifact store. | `path`, `content`, `content_type`?, `title`?, `tags`? |
| `save_transcript_artifact` | Fetch a YouTube transcript server-side (via the YouTube MCP) and save it as an artifact with your frontmatter. | `video_id`, `path`, `frontmatter`, `title`? |
| `send_telegram` | Send a message to the operator via Telegram. | `message` |
| `show_file` | Display a file inline in the chat UI. | `path`, `caption`? |
| `start_coding_task` | Background coding agent that edits the bound GitHub repo and opens a PR. | `task_description`, `title`?, `coding_context`?, `branch_name`?, `base_branch`? |
| `update_artifact` | Replace the content of an existing artifact, creating a new version. | `id`, `content`, `edit_summary`? |
| `web_fetch` | Read a web page (article text as markdown) without saving it. | `url`, `max_chars`? |
| `web_search` | Search the web for current information. | `query` |
| `write_file` | Write a scratch file to the project workspace. | `path`, `content` |

## Browser tools

Offered only when Playwright browser tools are enabled (`agent/browser_tools.py`).

| Tool | What it does | Parameters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `browser_click` | Click an element in the current page by CSS selector. | `selector` |
| `browser_close` | Close the current project's browser session and free resources. | — |
| `browser_open` | Open a URL in a persistent headless browser session. | `url` |
| `browser_read` | Get the visible text of the currently loaded page from the browser session. | `max_chars`? |
| `browser_screenshot` | Save a full-page screenshot of the current browser page into the project workspace. | `rel_path`? |
| `browser_type` | Type text into an input/textarea by CSS selector. | `selector`, `text`, `submit`? |
